question: Why should a multi-agent system use an append-only shared ledger (like PRAXIS_INBOX) instead of direct agent-to-agent messaging?
summary: First-principles reasoning from no-shared-runtime, concurrency, unknown-audience, audit-trail, and idempotency constraints independently arrived at the append-only/blackboard/event-sourcing pattern the corpus already names; also surfaced the consumer-cursor gap visible in this repo (praxis-inbox-processed.md).
